reviews.title: High quality at a competitive price
reviews.comment: I'm usually a fan of one of their competitors but I figured I'd give these guys a go, I'm happy I did. This unit has a robust case, sufficient heft to know that the inner workings are quality materials. It doesn't overheat and it us fast. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Austin J Richards

reviews.comment: Installed in my Kamrui mini pc. Easy installation, works exactly as expected.
reviews.author: Bernie

reviews.title: Initialization issues
reviews.comment: Now doing computer repair, I figured when other reviewers say they couldn't get the drive initiated, that they were doing so incorrectly. But they are right, I tried windows disc manager along with 3 other disc/partitioning  utilities. Finally had to use my non-system disc utility that worked. After initialization the disc works fine and is quite fast.
reviews.author: Lucky Seven Stables
